record.title: Include ADC capture modes in final guest health dispatch
record.intent: Correct the observed runner mode omission without changing the accepted native capture experiment.
requirements: Preserve the accepted private suite and original frozen manifests as historical evidence; add adcinputcontrol and adcinputmodel to the shared final-health dispatch.

Extend host runtime controls to exercise both new modes on success and failure, including boot failure and finalization paths, while retaining the existing mode controls. Do not launch a guest in this task.
Preserve the stock APK library capture binary and capture semantics; update only the runner route and its verification and frozen stock source identities as required.
Freeze a revised unexecuted stock input contract and matching stock verifier with mandatory generic health artifacts; retain the original stock freeze and cite the private result.

Verify the full stock profile against a synthetic independent-copy fixture and reject the stale runtime identity; preserve original evidence indexes. Commit and push before evaluation or guest execution.
acceptance: The routing repair and revised stock freeze are verified and pushed without a guest rerun.
